narrative.details:
We Zandalar know not of druidic ways; nature is to be shaped by our need, not the other way around.  Still, a haruspex is the one of us most in tune with nature, and rightly so.  To give up the ghost of a beastie is to know what it is to be one of them.  That is the real power of nature.

Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub, proving yourself to us.  Do this, and I'll give ya a powerful item - a belt used by many of the Zandalar's haruspices.

Strong mojo, ya mon!
narrative.objectives: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Sash.  Maywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale. You must also be Honored with Zandalar.
narrative.offerRewardText: I thank you - the latent power in these items will be treasures unto themselves, you betcha.  Not only have ya done as I've asked of ya, but you've also proven to be honorable to us here in the tribe.  As promised, here is your reward!
narrative.requestItemsText: Got the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub I need?  The haruspex's belt will be yours if ya have them.
